What is obesity? It's a question we all think we know the answer too, but I would like to take a second to reexamine the word.

In most recent memory of the meme of the internet, obesity has been explained as a person who is largely over weight. We call them fat, we call them whales, we call them hamplanets. We antagonize them. One could simply write the hate off as an extreme reaction to HAES. I know I did. Now though, other thoughts have popped into my head as to what the word could mean.

A body is determined by a physical size. We measure things by how heavy they are, a specific portion of weight. There has been a standard set applied by a scientific and factual bases as to what is overweight, or to put in a different term, fat. It's a unacceptable and irresponsible to act as if these standards don't exist, and don't exist without reason. Weight can also apply to the specific things we carry on ourselves on a day to day basis. We have so many things like cars If you carry a specific amount of weight on you, is there no standards that apply to that?

Then there is a soul. A soul is shapeless. It can be any color, it can be any shape, yet it is undefined. The soul is something that lay in the reaches of the unforeseeable corners of the universe. At the center of everything lays the soul, and it's claimed unfathomable to think every action can't affect the center of every being. We take actions every day that affect the core of our being that we disregard as acts that couldn't affect who we are, when in fact, they do.

Finally there is a life and how it lives; a life style. In our own culture we are on the very extreme of every side. We have Hummers and boats so big the run every day in the name of entertainment, that we are affecting the very planet we live on. This isn't aided by the fact some of us indulge so much they put other lives as risk or change. This change can be good and bad. Some people are so over weight that they demand the inconvenience of others. Other people drive so much and burn up so many resources they are affecting the ecosystem in a detrimental way. There are people who are so desperate or greedy they will rob from you and try to kill you. The ego in a culture can become so strong it is unable to apply shame and suffering to itself. It must exert itself outward to contain it's illusion it projects.

So what can we call someone who carries more than they need, who carries the most weight? What can we call the persons who are so ignorant and blind they can't see the consequences they are bringing upon themselves and others? What can we call one then, who denies the very essence of the soul? It may become common place to call these things suicidal maniacs and psychopaths. It will define a new negativity greater than the ones comprised of simple hate movements such as HAES and FPH. The change must be led for both sides to look at themselves and find the excess weight, to alter the course of where history is going, versus where we could go. It leaves me to wonder, what the true meaning of obesity is.
